integrity: Two complete exact integer enumerations of 3**12 states using distinct representations; independently reproduced occupancy minima, critical degeneracies, induced-matchings, and Curie ratio. Self-contained checker supplied. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite 12-vertex icosahedral graph; discrete classical spins; J>0, any real D, zero base magnetic field, homogeneous nearest-neighbor interactions. Curie response is the ordered field-derivative then zero-temperature limit. Does not establish thermodynamic phase transitions, quantum effects, disordered exchange, or historical uniqueness.
title: Induced-matching vacancies and an isolated Curie response in the spin-one icosahedral antiferromagnet
